''See also: [[Blue Light Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Blue [[Light]] is a luminous force that can be summoned by [[Alin]]. When manifested, it appears as [[sapphire]]-colored tendrils or tentacles that erupt from the earth, sometimes reaching heights of up to ten feet and possessing a thickness comparable to tree trunks. This power can be used for various purposes: it has been shown to protect [[Alin]] from external threats, induce unconsciousness in others without killing them, and even cause death in certain instances. The light is capable of communicating with [[Alin]], offering observations on justice and providing directives to save others. Once its task is complete, the essence of the Blue [[Light]] returns to [[Elysia]].}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Blue [[Light]] manifests as luminous, [[sapphire]]-like tendrils and tentacles that erupt from the ground with a thickness comparable to tree trunks. These translucent appendages possess the ability to bind targets, drain their strength, or hold individuals in a state of unconsciousness without causing death. Though it can be summoned by [[Alin]] as a coil, the entity is also characterized by a voice that begs for mercy. During its interactions with [[Alin]], it challenged his motivations by claiming his desires were not rooted in justice and ultimately challenged him to save it if he was capable.}}
